$comment: Trade terms are STEMS so one entry matches both source vocabularies: 'plumb' catches Apollo's 'plumbing services' and Google Maps' 'Plumber'. Full words like 'plumbing' silently reject every Maps listing categorised 'Plumber', which is how a 25% rejection rate went unnoticed. Matching is case-insensitive substring against the trade AND the company name.

geography.$note: Empty cities = anywhere in the listed states. Both empty = no geographic filter at all.
